notes.title: Small Bug Fixes & Goodbye to Black History Month
notes.notes:
Black History Month is almost over, and the next [b]Holiday event will be March 8th[/b] for International Women's Day. There are now [b]new skin tone options[/b] for hands as we say goodbye to February!

There will now be a [b]consent popup for new advertisements[/b] that will be added to the game in the future. Change what you are comfortable with at any time inside of the settings!

The [b]competitive default button[/b] for custom match lobbies now [b]mirrors the Slappyball League's ruleset[/b].

The [b]'On Fire' powerup is no longer automatically applied[/b], instead, the fire ball resource will be the only source for the power.

There is a [b]fix for ranked backfill not respecting rank[/b].

notes.notes:

[/list]

notes.title: Ranked Hot Patch
notes.notes:

[/list]

notes.title: Competitive Dive Changes & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h1]Keep giving us feedback on the new dive, and tell us if you have anymore issues with these bugs.[/h1]

[b]Reduced range[/b] of the competitive dive assist.

Players will [b]appear to teleport less often[/b] now on higher pings.

Fixed the ball sometimes [b]not being hittable at serve line[/b].

[b]Corrected the color order[/b] for customizing items with controller.

[h2]Give us more information if you see anymore issues with the following:[/h2]

Fix for ranked matchmaking entering an empty match when queuing for both ranked and casual

Fix for max number of players on server hosted custom limited to 6

Keep an eye out for the next build with a newly designed Daily Store with new cosmetics. And keep sending those bug reports in!

notes.title: Version .35 is live now!
notes.notes:
Improved [b]ball prediction and syncing[/b] when playing online matches. The ball location should now be more [b]accurate and responsive[/b]

[b]Improved performance[/b] in [b]all 3 arenas[/b]. Estimated at [b]more than 20% improvement[/b] in performance

[b]Ball max speed limited[/b] to help avoid balls being impossible to hit. Future updates will further limit flip hits to not be overpowered

[b]Reduced motion blur[/b]. We may introduce an option for increased motion blur in the future

Adjusted [b]collision [/b]on top of [b]colosseum poles[/b]

[b]3 point max size slightly reduced[/b], so even in high volley rounds there’s still strategy to positioning your hand

notes.title: Version .31 is out now with rank, jump boost, and quick chat changes!
notes.notes:
Added new [b]Diamond rank[/b] for top tier players - something to reach for past Gold III

[b]3 Point jump boost[/b] now only triggered when holding down new [b]boost button[/b]
[b]
Quick chat[/b] button now brings up a basic list of chat options, and the “I got it” “You get it” chats are [b]only triggerable[/b] with the [b]chat button held down[/b]

Added [b]rank name next to icon[/b] in matchmaking menu

[b]Dive assist disable option[/b] now [i]actually[/i] turns off the assist

notes.title: Version 0.24 Alpha: Slappypass Season 0 Live
notes.notes:
[h1]Slappyball has its very first Slappypass, Season 0 is out and ready![/h1]

[b]New hand design & animations[/b] are in, enjoy the new sneakers.

[b]Brand new arena[/b] to play in. Watch as the floating cars pass by and marvel in all the emissive glowing glory.

[b]Level up and earn new cosmetic items[/b]. Look like an edgy hero, or a kid playing with some cardboard.

[b]A few new basic cosmetics[/b] will also be available for y'all to purchase with Slappycoins.

[i]Also, psssssst, if you purchase the pass by Friday you can still get the two exclusive items![/i]

notes.title: Version 0.23 Alpha is out now!
notes.notes:
[b]Version 0.23 Alpha is out now![/b]

[b]Extra AI should no longer spawn[/b] in 2v2 and 1v1 matches 

[b]Fixed 2v2 and 1v1 backfill[/b] issues 

Potential fix for players queuing for 3v3 getting into 2v2 matches 

Potential fix for AI teams not serving sometimes in 2v2 and 1v1

[b]SlappyPass preorder available: launches October 6th![/b]
Available from the shop in game, with [b]two exclusive shirts[/b] for preordering!

notes.title: Version 0.22 Alpha is out!
notes.notes:
1v1 and 2v2 queues added. Can queue for any combination of 1v1, 2v2, or 3v3

Freeplay while matchmaking improvements

Added middle ad to stadiums to improve game sustainability

Fix that should reduce/resolve extra players on teams

notes.title: Version 0.21 Alpha
notes.notes:
Finally! Something to do during these long queues!

[b]Freeplay while matchmaking[/b] is now available! Solo and in parties.

[b]Store payments[/b] should be much less error prone.

[b]Stadium ads[/b] have been placed and aren't live quite yet.

[b]Custom Lobby Fixes[/b]: Lobby join errors should be greatly reduced & after leaving a private lobby match, players are no longer shoved into party, and can join/create another lobby.

[b]Fixed bug where finding a new match can get stuck waiting[/b] for party members if the party wasn’t the entirety of the team during the last match.

Next update will have the 1v1 and 2v2 queues and more bug fixes.

notes.title: Version 0.20.1 Alpha
notes.notes:
Small bug fix update here we go!

[b]Fixed crash[/b] from corrupted saves on start.

If you lost progress, reach out to amelorecoop@gmail.com with your log file and if verified, we will award you some slappycoins.

Added extra safety measures around saving to help [b]avoid future save corruptions[/b].

Party members are now the [b]proper color again[/b] on the main menu

notes.title: Version 0.20 Alpha
notes.notes:
It was a lot of work to get familiar with the existing project, but we got there! Enough for a small first update for everyone.

[b]Small performance update:[/b] frame rate limiting added by default, 30 in menus, 60 in gameplay. Previously it was unlimited, so this should help with GPU usage.

[b]No more lootboxes:[/b] The lootbox has been removed for now, Team Names are given on every level up.

[b]New cosmetic:[/b] Tattoos are added as a new cosmetic option to purchase. More colors and options will be available soon. Right now, you have to pick between wearing a Tattoo or wearing a Jersey, but we are hoping to change that in the next update.

[b]Analytics:[/b] Data to help us make major game design decisions.

[b]Logs:[/b] Steam builds now have logs so that crashes and other errors can be properly diagnosed.

notes.title: Week Two Update!
notes.notes:

- Added a spectator mode to custom matches

notes.title: One Week Update!
notes.notes:
[b]Version .17 Alpha[/b]
- Added a matchmaking player count to the find match button
- Added a ball depth meter at the top of the screen to help new players (can be turned off in options)
- Soft stopping while on the ground now locks your player in place while held
- Releasing set now does a "set hit" that can be used to set further horizontally (if timed correctly)
- Leaving matchmaking games early now gives a loss
- BUG FIX: Various individual leaderboard issues
- BUG FIX: Getting every random cosmetic from loot boxes will award coins now
- BUG FIX: Level 5 achievement not being awarded has been fixed
- BUG FIX: Teams should always been 3 v 3 in matchmaking (fixed 4 players on one team issue)
- BUG FIX: On-fire hits after a point is scored don't remove your on-fire state

notes.title: *Version .16.1 Alpha Hot Fix*
notes.notes:
- Speculative fix for players in the same party getting put on opposite teams
- Should also fix teams occasionally having 4 players

notes.title: Improved Matchmaking Update! (v.16 alpha)
notes.notes:
[b]Discovered a major issue with matchmaking backfill that should be addressed.[/b]
- Matchmaking queue times should be lower
- Fixed an issue with players in your party ending up on the other team
- Matchmaking games should backfill correctly if they start with less than 6 players or players leave
- Fixed a bug where players might see the wrong jersey on other players
